verdict.rationale: LibreOffice publishes a dedicated conversion filter reference (convertfilters.html) that lists formats with their filter names, MIME types and extensions, from Office Open XML, Pages and PageMaker to EPUB, SVG export and Parquet. Together with the documented --convert-to and --infilter syntax, this lets a power user check whether a given format pair has a filter before trying a conversion. missing for 10: an explicit input→output pairing matrix (which formats each app imports versus exports is only implied by filter names such as writer_*_Export), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the reference is accurate.
